text:
[RARC.6.2.1] Separate engines are independent ([RARC.1.2]) and may run at
the same time on different threads, for example several per-source engines of
one tier. Their streams are independent: no `seq` space is shared between
them. Correlation across sibling engines flows through an upstream engine:
each sibling's facts are bridged upward ([RARC.6.1.2]), and the upstream
engine consumes them in the order its integrator asserts them.
